PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the City Council or any of its Agencies listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.
Any written public record relating to an agenda item for an open session of a regular meeting of the City Council that is distributed to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting will be available for public inspection at City Hall in the City Clerk's office at 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, 3rd Floor during normal business hours (Monday - Thursday, 7:30 a.m. - 6:00 p.m.)

Staff recommends City Council waive further reading, read by title only and adopt Resolution No. 2011-010, entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, CALIFORNIA, SUPPORTING THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES, LOS ANGELES DIVISION, CALLING FOR A REASONABLE, PRACTICABLE, AND ECONOMICALLY ACHIEVABLE TMDL AND MUNICIPAL NPDES PERMIT REQUIREMENTS."

minutes_text:
CITY COUNCIL
MINUTES
CITY OF BALDWIN PARK
CITY COUNCIL
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 16, 2011
7:00 p.m. COUNCIL CHAMBERS
14403 E. Pacific Avenue
Baldwin Park
Manuel Lozano, Mayor / Chair
Marlen Garcia, Mayor Pro Tem / Vice Chair Council Members / Members: Monica Garcia, Ricardo Pacheco, Susan Rubio
Maria Contreras, City Treasurer Alejandra Avila, City Clerk
The CITY COUNCIL of the City of Baldwin Park met in REGULAR SESSION at the above time and place.
CALL TO ORDER
INVOCATION
Led by Council Member Pacheco
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
Present: Council Member Monica Garcia, Council Member Pacheco, Council Member Rubio, Mayor Lozano.
Absent: Mayor Pro Tem Marlen Garcia.
Also Present: Chief Executive Officer Singhal, City Attorney Pannone, Recreation & Community Services Director Carrillo, Community Development Manager Castagnola, Public Works Director Galvez, Chief Hadsell, Finance Director Quijano, City Clerk Avila, City Treasurer Contreras, Deputy City Clerk Nieto.
Mayor Pro Tem Marlen Garcia was excused
ANNOUNCEMENTS
Mayor Lozano expressed condolences for those affected by the earthquake in Japan
Council Member Monica Garcia requested that the meeting be adjourned in memory of Jorge Onate
Council Member Monica Garcia welcomed everyone to the meeting, saying that she was glad to see representation from all areas of the community. She acknowledged Homeboy/Homegirl Industries and asked that the Council adjourn the meeting in memory of Jaime Saldana, an individual who worked with the graffiti abatement crew with Homeboy Industries who passed away in 2007.
Mayor Lozano welcomed the Baldwin Park High School Soccer Team and asked that they donate a soccer ball to the Historical Society. He said that they would be featured in the Baldwin Park NOW
Council Member Rubio announced the upcoming Woman’s Club scholarship dinner
Council Member Pacheco welcomed all of those in attendance and noted the many positive things going on in Baldwin Park, get out the good news that there’s a lot of positivety, noting his agenda item re: rose float
PROCLAMATIONS, COMMENDATIONS & PRESENTATIONS
* Administration of Oath of Office and Certificate of Appointment to incoming Planning Commissioner Natalie Ybarra
Mayor Lozano welcomed Commissioner Ybarra and spoke about her accomplishments. He noted that she was one of the many graduates who stayed in the community
* Proclamation proclaiming March 14-19 as Adult Education Week in the City of Baldwin Park and certificate presentation to 2011 Adult Education Essay Contest winners & instructors
Mayor Lozano read the proclamation and introduced Dr. Kerr to accept it. He noted recent cutbacks in adult education and encouraged the community to support and demand these programs and services.
Dr. Kerr thanked the Mayor & City Council for all of their support and said that with their support and support from the District & community, adult education was doing fine.
Council Member Rubio announced that the adult school was celebrating its 50th anniversary
Council Member Monica Garcia acknowledged Dr. Kerr and Denise Tornatore for all that they do in the community for the residents. They worked very hard behind the scenes and do a lot for the community
Certificate presentation to Vance Weber of Homeboy Industries
Mr. Webster shared some words with the audience and expressed his gratitude for the opportunities he had through Homeboy Industries
Council Member Monica Garcia also spoke about Fr. Boyle and the influence he had in communities that he might not even be aware of. She noted a meeting that she had with him; she spoke about job training that was now being offered; inspiration from Fr. Boyle and Homeboy Industries
* Plaque presentation to the family of Jorge Onate, BPUSD Police Explorer
Mayor Lozano spoke about Jorge Onate and acknowledged all of the contributions that he had made in the community
Mayor Lozano acknowledged the school police officers and thanked them for the positive impacts that they make on the youth in the community
Officer Pope thanked the City as well as the Baldwin Park Police Department for honoring Jorge, noting the difficulty that they had been experiencing was made better by the support of the City and District. She said that Jorge would never be forgotten and would always be in their hearts
* Presentation to Baldwin Park Police Department Detective Diana Larriva in recognition of being named YWCA Woman of Achievement
Chief Hadsell introduced Det. Larriva and read the YWCA nomination that had been submitted
plaque for det. larriva
Asked that Det. Larriva be in the next issue of the NOW and on the marquee
* Presentation to the Baldwin Park High School Boys Soccer Team for being the 2011 CIF Champions
BPHS Soccer Coach was introduced and Mayor Lozano provided background on the team and said that they were going to place a billboard and on the NOW
Mayor asked that they also participate in the parade
Dr. Cruz also shared some words
Dr. Cruz asked for any donations for CIF rings
Mayor Lozano announced that the City Council would sponsor one ring each
Council Member Monica Garcia spoke about _____
Mayor Lozano introduced all of the winners of the essay contest
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
Ken Woods, resident & business owner expressed that he was pleased to see the automotive training center and Baldwin Park high school
Rebecca ______, BP resident presented a plaque to Council Member Rubio for her efforts in the community and spoke about the need for trees and their benefits; donated 10 trees to the City of Baldwin Park
Council Member Rubio thanked her and accepted the recognition on behalf of the City Council
Mike Salas, PW operations supervisor introduced __________, spoke about the upcoming event and thanked the Council for their support
Council Member Rubio expressed her excitement and thanked everyone for their efforts, brither communty with more trees
Danny Fierro, representing Assemblymember Roger Hernandez introduced himself and made himself available
John Rios, resident inquired about the status of Walnut Creek Nature Park; graffiti; suggested that they go after the swap meets wehre the paint is sold
Greg Tuttle, business owner spoke about the monthly financial report and disagreed with taking monies from PD asset forfeiture to pay for wages and overtime.
Magda Torrellas, resident expressed her disagreement with cutting any type of police services
Closed at 8:15
CONSENT CALENDAR
1. WARRANTS AND DEMANDS
Staff Report
City Council received and filed.
2. PROPOSED RECOGNITIONS BY THE MAYOR & CITY COUNCIL
Staff Report
City Council approved the preparation and presentation of plaques, proclamations and certificates as outlined in the staff report.
3. MINUTES
Staff Report
City Council approved the minutes of the March 9, 2011 meetings (special.)
4. CLAIM REJECTIONS
Staff Report
City Council rejected the claim of Pedro Nunez Vargas and directed staff to send the appropriate notice of rejection to the claimant.
5. CITY OF BALDWIN PARK’S COMPREHENSIVE ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2010
Staff Report
CAFR Report
City Council received and filed the City of Baldwin Park's Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2010.
6. METHODOLOGY OF SALES FOR THE NEIGHBORHOOD STABILIZATION PROGRAM HOMES LOCATED AT 4009 PUENTE, 4853 AZUSA CANYON ROAD AND 15113 BADILLO STREET
Staff Report
City Council approved the Neighborhood Stabilization Program Sales Plan establishing the policy for the sales of the properties located at 4009 Puente Avenue; 4853 Azusa Canyon Road; and 15113 Badillo Street.
7. TOURNAMENT OF ROSES PARADE FLOAT (Continued from March 9, 2011)
Staff Report
Council Member Pacheco spoke about this item and expressed the hope that there would be community volunteers to make this happen. He also asked if an advertisement could be put in the pamphlet in the Rose Parade. He thanked Chief Hadsell for preparing the report and wanted to move forward
Motion: Approve Staff recommends City Council consider Option 2 - direct Staff to make contacts with service organizations, residents, business owners and corporations who would be interested in forming a Baldwin Park Rose Float Association; or provide any other direction as the Council deems appropriate.
Moved by Mayor Pro Tem Pacheco, seconded by Councilmember Rubio.
8. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 2011-010, OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK SUPPORTING THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES, LOS ANGELES DIVISION, CALLING FOR REASONABLE, PRACTICABLE, AND ECONOMICALLY ACHIEVABLE TMDL AND MUNICIPAL NPDES PERMIT REQUIREMENTS
Staff Report
City Council waived further reading, read by title only and adopted Resolution No. 2011-010, entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, CALIFORNIA, SUPPORTING THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES, LOS ANGELES DIVISION, CALLING FOR A REASONABLE, PRACTICABLE, AND ECONOMICALLY ACHIEVABLE TMDL AND MUNICIPAL NPDES PERMIT REQUIREMENTS."
Motion: Approve w/ the exception of Item 7 (rp)
Moved by Mayor Lozano, seconded by Councilmember Monica Garcia.
SET MATTERS - PUBLIC HEARINGS
9. PUBLIC HEARING REGARDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2011-2012 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN AND CITIZEN PARTICIPATION PLAN (Continued from March 9, 2011)
Staff Report
Part 1
Part 2
Housing Manager Ruelas presented the report
Monica left at 8:17 p.m.
Mayor Lozano opened the public hearing for those wishing to speak in favor:
Colleen Castellano, w/ SGV Coalition for the Homeless
MAPS 4 College
Pastor Flores, Church of the Redeemer
Michael Ward, St. John's Social Services
Amy Graley, Santa Anita Services thanked the Council for their support
Mayor Lozano closed the public hearing.
Mayor Lozano noted that the budget reductions were made based on HUD
Motion: Approve Staff recommends that the City Council conduct the public hearing and following the public hearing, approve the allocations for the FY 2011-2012 CDBG public service programs by selecting either OPTION 1 - Approve E-Team's recommendations for funding
Moved by Councilmember Rubio, seconded by Mayor Lozano.
Concentrate on the anger management
CITY COUNCIL / CITY CLERK / CITY TREASURER / STAFF REQUESTS & COMMUNICATIONS
* Request by Mayor Lozano for discussion on the following:
Request for Council consideration to place the Baldwin Park High School Boys Soccer team on the City billboard in honor of their CIF Championship
Good to go
Council Member Rubio thanked all of the reps who were there
ADJOURNMENT
831
Laura M. Nieto, CMC
Deputy City Clerk
